question: Should this exact head proceed after physical-device validation and explicit authorization of the new WhatsApp dependency?
rationale: The design is coherent and member-authored, but only an authorized owner can accept the dependency graph and live WhatsApp compatibility risks.

options.title: Validate and authorize
options.body: Regenerate the docs map, run the physical-device matrix, and approve libphonenumber-js for the exact head before merge.

options.title: Reuse the proven alternative
options.body: Compare and adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85866 if its broader CLI surface is preferred and the branch can be brought current.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep both implementations open until maintainers select the permanent WhatsApp login and dependency direction.

recommendation.title: Validate and authorize
recommendation.body: Regenerate the docs map, run the physical-device matrix, and approve libphonenumber-js for the exact head before merge.
